title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Must-haves:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Experience – EC2, Security Groups, Command Line usage
  • Terraform Experience – Command line and coding experience to stand up cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update permissions on security groups (following existing formats)
  • Linux Environment – Experience with Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & Automation – Ability to write scripts for deployment using Packer or Terraform

Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products. Responsibilities include managing permissions, handling one-off requests via Slack, resolving access issues, and supporting releases for new services. You’ll be responsible for patching and maintaining cloud infrastructure, primarily in a Linux environment. You’ll use AWS (EC2, Security Groups) and Terraform to manage infrastructure as code, following established formats. Tasks also include scripting for deployment and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure smooth operations. Some exposure to Windows environments is acceptable, though the focus is on Amazon Linux.

Benefits Information – CLT

This is a CLT opportunity. You are eligible for 15 days annual holidays/sick time and 30 days annual time off. Benefits also include an FTGS contribution, social security contribution, and a meal voucher. Annual salary will be paid in local currency (REAL), and ranges based on years of experience and skillset. Full details on time off listed below. Medical/healthcare is NOT provided due to the public healthcare system.

EOR (CLT) in Brazil have all the statutory benefits:

  1. Meal Voucher
  2. Social Security
  3. Workers Compensation Insurance
  4. State Pension Fund

Paid Time Off

Both full-time and part-time employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid time off (PTO) a year. PTO accrues monthly at 2.5 days per month. Employees are eligible for annual leave after 1 year of work. During the first year of employment, an employee is not allowed to take any leave.

title: Account Manager, Enterprise Browser

title: Vendas internas
description:
Vaga: Inside Sales – CMII (CM Inteligência Imobiliária)

Local: Presencial – Edifício Trio Ribeirão Preto

Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira

Remuneração: Salário fixo + variável com Over Delivery (podendo chegar a R$ 7.000/mês)

Regime de contratação: MEI

Sobre a CMII

A CMII – CM Inteligência Imobiliária é um ecossistema de tecnologia que conecta inovação e performance ao mercado imobiliário.

Reunimos empresas e produtos que estão revolucionando o setor, como CliqueiMudei (portal imobiliário nacional), Leads4Sales (CRM e plataforma de geração de leads), Busca Inteligente (primeiro portal imobiliário via WhatsApp) e, em breve, Immob.ai (sistema de atendimento com inteligência artificial).

Nosso propósito é transformar a forma como imobiliárias, corretores e clientes se relacionam, utilizando dados, automação e inteligência artificial.

Responsabilidades do Inside Sales

O profissional será responsável por conduzir negociações e apresentar soluções tecnológicas para imobiliárias e corretores em todo o Brasil.

Sua missão é compreender as necessidades dos clientes, apresentar o valor das nossas plataformas e conduzir o processo de fechamento de novos negócios.

Atividades:

  • Realizar ligações e apresentações on-line para leads qualificados.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração e fechamento via videoconferência.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar propostas comerciais.
  • Atualizar e gerenciar informações no CRM (Leads4Sales).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de marketing e Customer Success para garantir uma jornada de cliente eficiente.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com vendas consultivas ou Inside Sales.
  • Boa comunicação e domínio de ferramentas digitais.
  • Perfil dinâmico, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Diferenciais: experiência com software SaaS, mercado imobiliário ou prospecção B2B.

O que oferecemos

  • Salário fixo + variável com Over Delivery (atingindo até R$ 7.000/mês).
  • Ambiente inovador e tecnológico, com foco em performance.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em um ecossistema de startups.
  • Trabalho presencial em um dos edifícios mais modernos de Ribeirão Preto.

Por que trabalhar na CMII

﻿A CMII é mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia: é um projeto nacional que está redefinindo o mercado imobiliário. Buscamos pessoas com energia, foco em resultados e vontade de crescer em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e alta performance.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor
description:
Job Description:

The Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading all Engineering teams within the plant, ensuring flawless and successful product launches and robust high-volume production processes. This role provides both functional and disciplinary leadership to manufacturing engineers and process technicians, guaranteeing performance, quality, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing activities..

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Management

  • Provide functional and disciplinary leadership to the Manufacturing Engineering teams.
  • Oversee process technicians, ensuring alignment with plant goals and operational excellence.
  • Lead decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and budgeting activities.
  • Monitor and control KPIs, define objectives, and ensure effective performance management and staff development.
  • Prepare and deliver regular reports to the Plant Manager.

Manufacturing Engineering

  • Lead Mechanical Engineering teams on all topics required to ensure program success from launch to mass production.
  • Ensure that robust, efficient, and safe production processes are implemented and sustained on the shop floor.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives following Mechanical Engineering standards, Lean methods, and EBOS principles.
  • Monitor process performance and ensure processes consistently deliver the expected results.

Engineering Change & Transfers

  • Own and manage local Engineering Change Management for product and process modifications, ensuring minimal impact on mass production lines.
  • Lead and oversee production transfers to and from the plant, ensuring seamless execution.

Quality & Customer Requirements

  • Ensure all customer requirements are met, including corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support product design and development activities to ensure compliance with manufacturing standards and process capabilities.

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
  • Post-graduate degree or MBA in engineering, manufacturing, management, or related areas.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in manufacturing engineering within an industrial environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and mechanical engineering applications in production.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with engineering change management (product and process).
  • Solid understanding of performance indicators, strategic planning, and budget management.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Inspirational, results-driven leadership.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
  • Proactive, organized, and with a strong systems-thinking mindset.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.

Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.

Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Presales Operations Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Presales Operations Specialist position focuses on serving as the main point of contact for non-commercial tickets in presales, ensuring RFIs and presentations are duly responded to with high content quality. This role combines operational excellence with content creation, requiring strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate across multiple departments to deliver exceptional presales support.

Key responsibilities:

- Handling the complete vendor onboarding process for new vendors, including managing registrations across client platforms while ensuring compliance and timely completion.

- Owning coordination and submission of Requests for Information (RFIs) by working with subject matter experts to gather content, ensure accuracy, and meet submission deadlines.

- Collaborating with internal groups to create compelling sales collateral, including presentations, case studies, and success cases tailored to support presales activities.

- Capturing key performance metrics and assisting in building reports to support presales operations.

- Tracking pre-sales ticket activities, managing RFx submissions and deadlines, ensuring timely delivery of responses and resolving any blockers to meet deadlines.

- Operations Experience: 3+ years of most recent experience in sales operations, presales support, or business operations.

- Industry Background: 3+ years in IT industry/consulting (most recent experience).

- Process Management: Proven experience with operational processes, ticket tracking, stakeholder follow-ups across departments, RFI and vendor onboarding processes.

- Analytics Skills: Strong capabilities in metrics and reporting.

- Content Creation: Demonstrated experience in content creation, presentations, and sales collaterals.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.

Additional skills preferred:

- Vendor Management: Familiarity with vendor onboardings, vendor registrations, and questionnaires.

- Outsourcing Experience: Experience in IT Outsourcing companies.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or Business Administration.

Benefits:

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, gosta de atuar em cenários desafiadores e quer contribuir em uma empresa que transforma vidas, essa oportunidade é para você.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados Sênior

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Estruturar e manter os processos de ingestão de dados de múltiplos serviços, sistemas e fontes externas da plataforma, focando em alta performance e qualidade dos dados;

• Entender profundamente a plataforma técnica para identificar novas fontes e evoluções necessárias, com suporte do time de tecnologia;

• Você será a “Força” do time de Engenharia de Dados dentro dos squads de tecnologia e deve ser capaz de entregar de ponta a ponta as demandas específicas, alinhando processos, dependências e suporte com o time do CoE de Dados;

• Criação e sustentação de pipelines de integração dos dados do ambiente de produção por CDC;

• Otimização do processamento dos dados para alta disponibilidade;

• Soluções de integração de dados externos (parceiros e outros sistemas), via API, FTP ou consumo direto de flat files;

• Orquestração de todas as dependências (pré e pós) e garantida de entrega;

• Mapeamento de evolução da plataforma de dados e adequação a novas implementações técnicas;

• Manutenção de Estruturas de Dados para consumo específico, como Data Marts e Feature Stores;

title: Analista de Cobrança TM Digital
description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Manter agenda contínua de visitas técnicas aos clientes para fortalecer o relacionamento, monitorar a evolução dos negócios e avaliar riscos locais, com produção de relatórios específicos sobre clientes e contexto da filial.

Esta função combina conhecimento regulatório, validação da mecânica dos jogos e experiência em localização para adaptar os recursos do produto ao mercado brasileiro, tanto do ponto de vista técnico quanto da experiência do usuário.

  • Interpretar as regulamentações brasileiras de jogos de azar (Portaria 722, Portaria 1207, etc.) e garantir que as mecânicas proprietárias dos jogos estejam em conformidade com os requisitos legais.
  • Validar modelos matemáticos, estruturas de pagamento, uso de RNG (Gerador de Números Aleatórios), lógica de jackpot, sugerir adaptações nas mecânicas de jogo e volatilidade para verificar a conformidade antes do envio aos laboratórios de certificação.
  • Preparar a documentação técnica exigida pelas entidades de certificação, incluindo regras do jogo, metodologia de RNG, divulgações de RTP (Retorno ao Jogador), tabelas de probabilidade e fluxo operacional.
  • Identificar riscos de conformidade na avaliação inicial e propor ajustes ou mecânicas alternativas para garantir a aprovação com segurança e o mínimo de retrabalho.
  1. Lógica, Matemática e Mecânicas do Jogo
  • Revisar e validar a matemática do jogo: valor esperado, frequência de pagamento, curvas de volatilidade, distribuição de prêmios, exposição ao risco, RTP e impacto promocional.
  • Trabalhar com designers e desenvolvedores matemáticos para garantir que a lógica de probabilidade seja transparente e tecnicamente comprovável.
  • Apoiar testes A/B e simulações para verificar os resultados esperados e relatar discrepâncias. Localização e Experiência do Usuário
  • Adaptar jogos ao mercado brasileiro sob uma perspectiva cultural e comportamental, incluindo temas visuais, elementos de UI/UX, som, terminologia e ritmo de jogo.
  • Contribuir com ideias para o design do estúdio, dublagens, apresentadores e elementos na tela, alinhados ao público local.
  • Sugerir ajustes na dificuldade do jogo, distribuição de prêmios, preços e fluxo de integração com base nos padrões de comportamento do usuário no Brasil.
  1. Colaboração Interdepartamental
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes de produto, desenvolvimento, estúdios, jurídico/conformidade e laboratórios de certificação.
  • Traduzir requisitos técnicos e matemáticos em tarefas claras para designers e engenheiros.
  • Analisar designs de estúdio e protótipos de jogos, fornecendo feedback estruturado sobre conformidade, clareza e adequação ao mercado.

PROCURAMOS ALGUÉM QUE TENHA:

  • Experiência com design e desenvolvimento de jogos, matemática aplicada a jogos (RTP, RNG, volatilidade, modelagem de probabilidade) e/ou processos de certificação.

title: Coordenador de RH

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO

Coordenação de Rotinas de RH

  • Conduzir e supervisionar rotinas generalistas de admissão, movimentações, férias, ponto, afastamentos e desligamentos.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de RH (turnover, absenteísmo, headcount, perfis críticos etc.) e propor melhorias.

  • Apoiar ciclos de avaliação de performance, mérito e promoção.

  • Contribuir com projetos corporativos de RH, garantindo execução e adaptação à realidade da unidade.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES

  • Implementar, suportar e administrar ambientes Linux.
  • Provisionar, gerenciar e otimizar recursos de computação, armazenamento e rede nas plataformas CloudStack, KVM e Proxmox.
  • Desenvolver e implementar scripts e automações para otimizar processos de gestão, manutenção e monitoramento da infraestrutura.
  • Automatizar processos de Integração Contínua (CI), Entrega Contínua (CD) e implantação (Deployment) de ambientes.

  • Garantir a disponibilidade, estabilidade e escalabilidade de ambientes e sistemas críticos.
  • Resolver incidentes, problemas e troubleshooting de alta complexidade relacionados às plataformas de nuvem e serviços de infraestrutura.
  • Implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança, backup e recuperação de desastres.

REQUISITOS

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Redes de Computadores ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada em sistemas Linux, Proxmox, KVM e CloudStack.
  • Inglês técnico.

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de TI, tais como, servidores, redes, storage, virtualização, sistemas operacionais, segurança e cloud.
  • Experiência e domínio em Docker, Docker Compose e Kubernetes.
  • Domínio pleno em sistemas operacionais Linux
  • Experiência sólida com plataformas de virtualização e nuvem como Proxmox, KVM, OpenStack e CloudStack.
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência com CEPH ou soluções similares.
  • Conhecimento em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle, etc.).
  • Experiência com práticas e conceitos de DevOps.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex: Ansible, Terraform, Puppet).

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Certificações em Linux ou outras tecnologias relevantes.
  • Experiência com o stack de monitoramento (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK Stack ou ferramentas APM).

Salário Fixo (CLT) a combinar ou PJ

title: Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil)
description:
We are a leading global fintech company providing cross-border payment solutions to enterprises worldwide, with operations across North America, Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. As we strategically expand into the Brazilian market, we are seeking a seasoned Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil) to ensure full compliance of our local operations with Brazilian financial regulations, data protection laws (LGPD), AML/KYC requirements, and payment system frameworks. This role will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators (e.g., Banco Central do Brasil, Receita Federal, ANPD), lead compliance implementation, adapt technical systems to regulatory expectations, and support routine audits, while closely collaborating with global compliance and engineering teams to embed compliance into product development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical compliance liaison between the company and Brazilian regulators (including but not limited to Banco Central do Brasil, CVM, ANPD, Receita Federal);representing the engineering in regulatory engagements that involve system architecture, data flows, business contingency, audit logging, and other technical implementation aspects of compliance.
  • Participate in Brazil market-related requirements and project reviews, providing technical compliance oversight to assess requirements and ensure that products, technical architecture, and operational processes comply with Brazilian financial, payments, and data privacy regulations (such as LGPD, PIX-related rules, and BCB Resolutions), thereby enabling legally compliant business operations.;
  • Collaborate with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications and system controls;
  • Support internal and external audits (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) and prepare regulatory filings and compliance reports;
  • Continuously monitor regulatory developments in Brazil, assess impact on existing business and technical architecture, and propose mitigation strategies;
  • Drive the systematic and standardized documentation of technical artifacts to enhance compliance efficiency and auditability;
  • Provide compliance training and guidance to local business teams to foster a strong compliance culture.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • Language : Native-level Portuguese (written and spoken); fluent English for global collaboration;
  • Local Regulatory Knowledge : Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial regulatory landscape, including BCB payment system rules (e.g., PIX, SPB), AML/CFT regulations, and LGPD data protection requirements;
  • Technical Acumen : Familiarity with modern payment technology architectures (e.g., API-first, microservices, cloud infrastructure); ability to engage engineering teams on technical details such as data flows, encryption, and audit logging;
  • Hands-on Experience : Direct experience engaging with Brazilian regulators, submitting licensing applications, or managing on-site inspections;
  • Education : Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law, Finance, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hold professional certifications such as CISSP, CAMS, CRCM, or similar;
  • Prior experience in fintech, payment institutions, or banking compliance roles;
  • Familiarity with international compliance standards (e.g., FATF Recommendations, GDPR, PCI-DSS) and their local implementation;
  • Experience working in multicultural teams and supporting cross-border compliance initiatives.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class compliance and engineering experts;
  • Continuous professional development and learning resources;
  • Inclusive, diverse, and results-driven culture.

title: Senior Front-End Engineer (React / Typescript) | Remote | Worldwide
description:
Senior Front-End Engineer ( React / Typescript ) | Remote | Worldwide

Upstack Data

Full-Time Remote | Worldwide

$3,500 - $6,000 USD monthly salary

Role hours require working US Eastern Timezone

About Upstack Data

We're a customer identity resolution platform helping marketing teams connect ad spend to actual customer behavior. We're a small but fast-growing bootstrapped SaaS company based in the USA with a fully remote team.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and product-minded Senior Frontend Engineer to join Upstack Data, a customer identity resolution platform helping marketing teams connect ad spend to actual customer behavior. In this role, you will own our frontend applications—both our React-based B2B SaaS product and react based admin tools. You will work directly with our CEO to translate business requirements into high-quality code, making independent UI/UX decisions throughout the product development lifecycle from initial concept to deployment and optimization.

A distinguishing aspect of this role is your ability to design clean, modern interfaces without relying on dedicated designers. You will influence product and technology decisions, establish our component library and design system, and build interfaces for complex features including dashboards, analytics views, data tables, integration settings, and billing flows. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about creating impactful B2B SaaS products, with strong product sense and an understanding of what makes tools like Stripe, Linear, and Vercel feel intuitive and polished.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience developing production React applications with TypeScript
  • Strong experience with types and backend API calls
  • Expert proficiency in modern React patterns including hooks, context API, composition, and performance optimization
  • Strong experience with shadcn/ui, Radix UI, or similar headless component libraries
  • Solid understanding of Tailwind CSS and modern CSS practices (flexbox, grid, responsive design)
  • Strong UI judgment and ability to design intuitive interfaces independently without designer mockups
  • Experience building B2B SaaS applications with understanding of common UI patterns (data tables, filters, dashboards, forms, settings)
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services and third-party platforms (Stripe, analytics, marketing tools)
  • Experience with Git workflows and modern deployment practices
  • Knowledge of frontend testing frameworks and best practices for code quality
  • Excellent communication skills and autonomous problem-solving abilities
  • Available for 4-5 hours overlap with US Eastern timezone
  • Strong english verbal and written communication.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality React components and features for our SaaS application using TypeScript and shadcn/ui
  • Make independent UI/UX decisions on layouts, user flows, information hierarchy, and interaction patterns that create intuitive user experiences
  • Collaborate with the CEO on product requirements, providing technical perspective on feasibility and proposing alternative approaches that balance user value with engineering effort
  • Establish and maintain our component library and design system to ensure consistency and reusability across the application
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to establishing frontend engineering standards and best practices
  • Optimize application performance focusing on Core Web Vitals, bundle sizes, load times, and overall user experience
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services including payment processors, analytics platforms, and marketing tools
  • Write comprehensive tests using modern testing frameworks to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Monitor and analyze frontend performance metrics, addressing issues proactively
  • Identify opportunities for technical improvements and innovations to enhance both product quality and development efficiency
  • Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of applications in production environments
  • Stay current with React ecosystem trends and emerging frontend technologies to continuously improve our product offerings

Compensation & Application

Fully remote position.

A Offerwise é uma empresa especializada em pesquisa de mercado, com sede em Belo Horizonte (MG) e presença internacional por meio de escritórios na Colômbia, México e Argentina. title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Analyst - Machine and Equipment Development
description:
Job Description:

The Manufacturing Engineering Analyst will be responsible for developing, defining, and industrializing machines, equipment, and tooling for the manufacturing plants in South America. This role acts strategically in production process planning, defining technical requirements, overseeing equipment construction, and supporting installation and commissioning on the shop floor. The position requires strong technical expertise, project management skills, and hands-on experience with national and international suppliers.

Main Responsibilities:

Machine, Equipment, and Tooling Development

  • Develop machines, equipment, and tooling for South American plants, from concept through final validation.
  • Provide technical oversight of design and construction with local and international suppliers.
  • Conduct supplier technical development, ensuring compliance with engineering requirements and company standards.

Process Planning and Design

  • Define acquisition and industrialization schedules for tools and equipment.
  • Design manufacturing processes and production line layouts according to Mechanical Engineering Fundamentals, ergonomic standards (EAWS), and customer-defined cycle times.
  • Apply Virtual Engineering and Process Development tools, including digital planning, simulations of material flow, operators, robots, and forming processes.

Quality, Traceability, and HSE

  • Define and implement traceability concepts in alignment with IT.
  • Align inspection concepts with the Quality team and ensure proper implementation.
  • Ensure compliance with Mechanical Engineering standards, Quality Fundamentals, and Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) requirements.

Supplier and Procurement Management

  • Create SORs (specification books) for standard equipment, detailing technical requirements.
  • Initiate supplier scouting and evaluation, and create requirement lists for tools and equipment.
  • Recommend suppliers based on technical requirements, analyses, and delivery capability.
  • Support the approval process for tools and equipment, including interface with Purchasing and preparation of purchase requests.
  • Oversee installation and support the launch responsible during commissioning of tools and equipment.

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Production Engineering, or related fields.

Experience and Technical Knowledge

  • Strong experience in developing machines, equipment, and tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with industrial projects, equipment construction, and technical follow-up with suppliers.
  • Experience with international suppliers and solid understanding of technical procurement processes.
  • Knowledge of simulations and digital tools for process engineering.
  • Advanced English.
  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles, industrial ergonomics (EAWS), and engineering standards.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Clear and assertive communication with internal teams and suppliers.
  • Organization, discipline, and strong results orientation.
  • Teamwork ability and technical project management skills.
  • Proactivity and ability to work in multidisciplinary environments.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer (Node.js / React / AdTech) – Contract (6+ Months, Extension Likely)

Location: Remote (EU Time Zones)

Contract Length: 6 months – strong potential for long-term extensions

Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: Node.js, React, APIs, Social/YouTube integrations, AdTech, Creator/UGC discovery

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly experienced Product Engineer to help build a next-generation AdTech platform , supporting categories such as beauty, lifestyle, UGC, and topic-based recommendations for a Euro Retail and Marketing powerhouse.

This contract role sits inside a fast-moving, cross-functional product team building internal tools and white-labelled solutions used across wider business units. You’ll be responsible for scoping, designing, and developing features end-to-end — from backend services to polished, user-friendly front-end experiences.

This is a hands-on build role , perfect for an engineer with strong product instincts and experience delivering consumer-facing or AdTech-driven discovery systems.

Key Responsibilities

Product Engineering & Feature Ownership

  • Build and evolve a creator discovery solution end-to-end using Node.js and React
  • Own product features from concept → prototype → implementation → iteration
  • Work closely with product managers, data teams, and internal partners to define requirements
  • Rapidly test, validate, and iterate on user workflows and ranking experiences

API & Platform Integrations

  • Integrate with social-platform APIs (e.g., YouTube Data API , Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest)
  • Develop services to ingest, enrich, and structure creator data (categories, topics, UGC signals, relevance scoring)
  • Optimise ingestion and discovery pipelines for performance and scale

AdTech & Recommendation Work

  • Build components that support advertising partners, sponsorship matching, and creator-brand fit
  • Implement logic for topic/category classification, recommendation ranking, and metadata structuring
  • Work on internal tools and white-label solutions used by cross-functional teams

Backend & Frontend Engineering

  • Build scalable backend services in Node.js (REST, GraphQL, event-driven services)
  • Develop polished UIs in React , ensuring high usability and clarity for internal teams
  • Ensure strong code quality, automated testing, and reliable CI/CD

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner closely with engineering leads, PMs, data scientists, and marketing/AdTech teams
  • Operate in a rapid, iterative environment with short feedback loops
  • Participate in architectural decisions and contribute to long-term platform direction
  • Support a healthy engineering culture focused on velocity, clarity, and product impact

Required Experience

  • 5+ years as a product-focused engineer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and React
  • Experience integrating with social media APIs (YouTube essential; Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest a plus)
  • Experience in AdTech, marketing tech, creator platforms, or discovery/recommendation systems
  • Experience building internal tools, dashboards, or white-label solutions
  • Strong product mindset — comfortable owning features, making trade-offs, and shipping iteratively
  • Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear technical plans
  • Strong communication, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional collaboration

Nice to Have

  • Experience with video/content metadata (categories, beauty, topics, “lookalike” discovery)
  • Understanding of ranking, scoring, or classification models
  • Background with UGC/creator ecosystems (YouTube creators, UGC workflows, performance marketing)
  • Experience with event-driven microservices or data pipelines
  • GraphQL experience
  • Experience in high-scale consumer-facing platforms

Why This Role?

  • High-impact greenfield project
  • Central to the business’ advertising & creator strategy
  • Autonomy to shape the product and tech direction
  • Flexible remote contract with extensions very likely

title: Junior Recruiter
description:

Interviews will be conducted in English

Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

Você será responsável por revisar proativamente os candidatos para determinar se eles atendem aos requisitos rigorosos e à experiência de trabalho para perfis farmacêuticos complexos, garantindo uma experiência premium, contínua e elevada para todos os candidatos e partes interessadas.

O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Engajamento de Candidatos e Gerentes de Contratação: Cultivar relacionamentos fortes, atuando como um concierge profissional para garantir uma experiência elevada durante todo o processo.
  • Revisão e Apresentação de Candidatos: Revisar, triar, pré-qualificar e apresentar talentos proativamente, incluindo a capacidade de desmembrar perfis complexos para uma busca eficaz e uma comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Liderança no Processo de Candidatura: Conduzir os candidatos pelas etapas iniciais do processo de candidatura com foco em velocidade, discrição e qualidade.
  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais para aprimorar a estratégia e as operações de recrutamento.

✅ O Que Você Precisa Trazer

Candidatos bem-sucedidos são definidos por sua estabilidade, comunicação e abordagem orientada a processos.

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.
  • Educação: Bacharelado ou atualmente matriculado para obter um.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral que refletem um profissionalismo de natureza polida.
  • Idiomas: Fluência em Português e Inglês é obrigatória para prospecção no Brasil e colaboração com partes interessadas internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Sistemas: Experiência comprovada com Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS) e um sólido entendimento de produtos MS Office/Google.
  • Mentalidade: Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe, aceitar direção e executar um plano, e possuir uma forte orientação para detalhes com acompanhamento demonstrada em empregos anteriores.

✨ O Que Você Ganha

  • Junte-se a um líder de mercado global em serviços de RH com reconhecimento da indústria.
  • Junte-se a um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.
  • Acesse uma ampla gama de oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa que oferece um ótimo equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa com processos comprovados e tecnologia de alta produção para criar eficiência.

As candidaturas serão aceitas continuamente até que a vaga seja preenchida.

Junior Recruitment Analyst - Hybrid (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)

This role requires a minimum of three days per week on-site in our Rio de Janeiro office.

Role Summary: Concierge-Level Recruitment Excellence

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature , process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.

What You Get To Do

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.
  • Candidate Review & Presentation: Proactively review, screen, pre-qualify, and present talent, including the ability to break down complex profiles for effective searching and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Application Process Leadership: Lead candidates through the initial stages of the application process with a focus on speed, discretion, and quality.
  • Process Compliance & System Administration: Ensure stability in previous roles and manage complex processes with strict adherence to recruitment process compliance and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration.
  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.

✅ What You Need To Bring

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar na construção e evolução de nossas arquiteturas e pipelines de dados em larga escala, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de analytics, ciência de dados e inteligência artificial.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter arquiteturas de processamento de dados em grande escala.
  • Garantir estruturas adequadas para criação de modelos de dados para análises preditivas e machine learning.
  • Implementar soluções com foco em governança e segurança dos dados (data lakes, data warehouses e data lakehouses).
  • Projetar e otimizar infraestruturas de dados, incluindo bancos de dados, orquestradores e pipelines.
  • Construir e automatizar pipelines de ETL/ELT integrando múltiplas fontes (SQL, APIs, websites, eventos).
  • Gerenciar fluxos de dados, assegurando disponibilidade, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Garantir aderência aos padrões de extração e processamento (streaming e batch).
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) com tendências e novas tecnologias de engenharia de dados.

Requisitos

  • Formação em TI, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência em engenharia de dados.
  • Inglês avançado para interação com parceiros globais e leitura técnica.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais

Programação e Pipelines de Dados:

  • Python e/ou Scala.
  • Experiência com Airflow, Spark e Kafka.

Bancos de Dados:

  • Domínio de SQL e bancos relacionais.
  • Desejável: NoSQL (MongoDB, HBase, Cassandra).

Cloud e Big Data:

  • Experiência comprovada em AWS (EC2, S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, API Gateway, Cloud9, CloudWatch, Lake Formation).
  • Desejável conhecimento em GCP e Azure .
  • Vivência com Spark, Hadoop e processamento distribuído.
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS).
  • Metodologias ágeis + ferramentas: Git, Jira, Confluence, Slack.

Governança e Arquitetura de Dados:

  • Conhecimento em governança (DAMA-DMBOK) e arquitetura de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP S/4 HANA e SAP Analytics Cloud .
  • Conhecimento em Aecorsoft Data Integrator .
  • Habilidades de front-end e design para criação de dashboards.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, MicroStrategy).
  • Conhecimento em DevOps, IaC (Terraform) e ferramentas de monitoramento (CloudWatch, New Relic).

Sobre o Grupo Multilaser

O Grupo Multilaser foi fundado em 1987. Desde lá, seguimos crescendo, ampliando mercado e construindo parcerias duradouras junto aos nossos colaboradores, consumidores, clientes e investidores.

Temos 4 atributos importantes que nos definem: somos democráticos, humanos, antenados e descontraídos. Um dos nossos principais pilares é facilitar a vida das pessoas através da tecnologia. Em nossa Cultura, temos 3 pilares que nos orientam e direcionam: Gerar valor ao cliente, Fazer o certo do jeito certo e Sinceridade com Respeito.

Atuamos em mais de 15 categorias, temos 3 fábricas no Brasil e um laboratório na China, além dos escritórios em São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. São mais de 5 mil itens em portfólio, presentes em mais de 40 mil pontos de venda e em mais de 30 marketplaces parceiros.

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities:

- Must know the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues

- Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must

- Rigorous attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Understanding of Test management

- Understanding of Trade life cycle

- Understanding of Market Data management

- Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.

- Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.

- Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.

- Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.

- Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.

- Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

title: Gerente de Vendas - Brasil
description:
Título do cargo: Gerente de Vendas – Brasil

Departamento: Vendas – APC , América Latina

Reporta a: Diretor de Vendas, América Latina

Propósito :

Impulsionar o crescimento comercial e técnico dos produtos da APC (plasma, hemácias e outros ingredientes do Grupo Lauridsen) nos mercados de suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura no Brasil, com foco na geração de demanda, no desenvolvimento de distribuidores, consultores e key accounts.

Responsabilidades:

Estratégia de vendas

  • Liderar e executar o plano de vendas e negócios para a linha de produtos APC no Brasil, alinhado com as metas da APC em nível global.
  • Desenvolver e manter negócios com key accounts, incluindo cooperativas, premixeiras e fábricas de ração. Manter bom relacionamento com os clientes existentes e identificar um forte pipeline de oportunidades.
  • Selecionar / avaliar e nomear novos distribuidores para estados potenciais. Capacidade de gerenciar, motivar e treinar distribuidores.
  • Conhecimento técnico para promover ingredientes especiais e capacidade de demonstrar valor / retorno sobre investimento.
  • Conhecimento prático nas indústrias de Suínos, Aves e Aquicultura no mercado brasileiro. Liderar e impulsionar a ativação de novos negócios e manter bom relacionamento com tomadores de decisão-chave será uma vantagem adicional.
  • Formular estratégias comerciais para atingir as metas acordadas de vendas, margens e gestão de crédito para o Brasil.
  • Implementar o plano estratégico para expandir os negócios da APC no Brasil, incluindo gestão de canais.
  • Negociar preços e manter margens alinhadas aos objetivos regionais e globais.
  • Gestão de produto e planejamento estratégico.
  • Análise de dados para tomada de decisão (disponibilidade, demanda, capacidade).
  • Gerenciar estrategicamente os estoques das fábricas, garantindo eficiência e agilidade frente a diferentes cenários de demanda.
  • Demonstrar boa capacidade de escuta ativa, atendendo de forma eficaz clientes internos e externos.

Estratégia de marketing

  • Implementar o posicionamento adequado dos produtos e definir metas de desenvolvimento focadas para o Brasil.
  • Assegurar um bom entendimento das necessidades dos clientes, das condições de mercado e das atividades dos concorrentes para desenvolver estratégias de produto e de canais.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com time regional e global para obter o suporte necessário.
  • Desenvolver um plano de marketing por meio de anúncios, feiras, seminários, eventos, entre outras atividades.

Requisitos:

Este cargo exige capacidades para aplicar habilidades de negócios e técnicas relacionadas às diferentes aplicações por espécie e ao uso dos produtos. Além disso, o ocupante da posição deve compreender as necessidades do mercado, identificar oportunidades e disseminar informações sobre os produtos, apoiando as áreas técnica e de marketing no desenvolvimento de planos/estratégias para o crescimento do negócio.

Condições de trabalho:

Esta posição exige que o ocupante viaje regularmente a trabalho. Além disso, o titular do cargo passa tempo nos seguintes ambientes: escritórios administrativos, conferências e escritórios de clientes. 

  • A vaga é destinada a cidadãos e residentes no Brasil.
  • Trabalho remoto com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (40–60% do tempo).
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo com bônus por desempenho.
  • Suporte regional e conexão com a estrutura técnica/comercial global.

Qualificações:

  • Formação acadêmica em Zootecnia, Medicina Veterinária ou Agronomia, com conhecimento em Gestão de Negócios ou Marketing e paixão pela indústria de nutrição animal.
  • Cerca de 5 a 10 anos de experiência relevante em vendas e marketing na indústria B2B de nutrição animal.
  • Perfil comercial, postura prática e proativa, com boas habilidades de comunicação.
  • Sensibilidade multicultural e fluência em inglês.
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas em suinocultura, avicultura e aquicultura.

Sobre a APC

A APC é líder mundial na produção e comercialização de proteínas sanguíneas derivadas de plasma e hemácias. Nossa história começou em 1981, quando os cientistas da APC descobriram o poderoso papel que as proteínas funcionais derivadas do plasma desempenham em ajudar a apoiar e manter a função imunológica em animais. O negócio pioneiro focado em estudos científicos rendeu mais de 600 artigos publicados em revistas científicas internacionais e mais de uma dúzia de patentes relacionadas à coleta e processamento das proteínas do sangue e do plasma. Hoje, a APC emprega mais de 500 pessoas e opera 17 fábricas em oito países em todo o mundo. A APC continua comprometida com a essência de sua missão de ajudar animais a atingir o melhor desempenho por meio do uso de proteínas funcionais inovadoras que impactam positivamente a saúde animal.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React

*Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

*Nosso cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente que atua no segmento de fabricação e comercialização de eletrodomésticos e eletroportáteis.

*O que buscamos?

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior com sólida experiência em Node.js, React, SQL, Crons, Docker, Argo CD, Sequelize e TypeORM. O profissional será responsável por um novo projeto.

*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Node.js, utilizando Sequelize e TypeORM para interação com bancos de dados relacionais.

• Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços para comunicação entre sistemas.

• Implementar e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React.js e TailwindCSS.

• Criar e gerenciar tarefas agendadas (crons) para automação de processos críticos.

• Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e orquestração com Argo CD.

• Desenvolver consultas otimizadas em SQL Server, PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

• Atuar na integração e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para garantir entregas contínuas e seguras.

• Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas de performance e segurança no backend e frontend.

• Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, garantindo boas práticas de Clean Code e Design Patterns.

*O que você precisa ter

• Experiência avançada com Node.js (Express, NestJS).

• Experiência com React.js e boas práticas de frontend.

• Conhecimento sólido em bancos SQL e ORM (Sequelize e TypeORM).

• Experiência com criação e gerenciamento de Jobs/crons para automação.

• Conhecimento avançado em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de containers.

• Experiência com orquestração de deploys usando Argo CD.

• Prática com CI/CD e deploys automatizados.

• Boa experiência com integração de APIs e segurança (JWT, OAuth, OpenID).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em estruturas de dados, algoritmos e padrões de arquitetura.

*Diferenciais:

• Experiência com NestJS e arquitetura Clean Code.

• Conhecimento em Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código.

• Experiência com mensageria (Redis).

• Conhecimento em React Native.

Observações:

• Oportunidade para 6 meses iniciais e grande possibilidade de prorrogação.

*Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Híbrido em Curitiba – PR, no Bacacheri. São 3 dias presenciais e 2 remotos. O dia que todos vão presencial é na quarta e os outros 2 dias de presencial o profissional pode escolher. Importante ressaltar que o primeiro mês é 100% presencial para imersão no ambiente, treinamentos e alinhamentos. O híbrido se aplica a partir do mês subsequente.

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote

The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable: Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

description:
São Paulo/SP - Brazil

SiiLA is the dominant authority in commercial real estate news, data, and analysis across Latin America. Since our founding in 2015, we have built a reputation for delivering precise , reliable market intelligence with a relentless commitment to quality and integrity .

Powered by cutting-edge technology, SiiLA transforms raw data into actionable insights through subscription-based solutions trusted by the world’s top commercial real estate professionals. Our platform offers unparalleled transparency , empowering clients to make informed decisions in a rapidly evolving industry.

Visit our website: siila.com.br

About the Role:

Are you passionate about commercial real estate, technology, and helping others succeed? SiiLA is looking for an Account Executive who combines business acumen with a consultative approach to selling.

This is not just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing organization where your efforts will directly influence our continued success. We’re looking for someone who is eager to become an expert in our products, understands the nuances of the commercial real estate industry, and embraces the challenge of developing long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop a deep understanding of SiiLA’s products, data, and the commercial real estate market to build credibility and be a trusted advisor to clients.
  • Understand the Platform's Advertising Features: Gain a deep knowledge of the platform’s advertising offerings, tools, and capabilities to effectively showcase the benefits to potential clients and maximize their value.
  • Strategize Advertising Solutions: Work closely with the marketing team to design customized advertising solutions for clients, utilizing platform features to target the right audience and enhance commercial real estate market visibility.
  • Client Consultation & Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients’ needs and leveraging the platform’s advertising tools to achieve their business objectives, particularly in the commercial real estate sector.
  • Actively identify and qualify new business opportunities, leveraging a consultative selling approach to tailor solutions to client needs.
  • Engage with prospects through persistent outreach, effective listening, and thoughtful presentations to communicate SiiLA’s value proposition.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Continuously monitor the performance of advertising campaigns on the platform, providing clients with insights and recommendations to optimize their campaigns.
  • Educate Clients on the Platform’s Value: Conduct presentations, training sessions, and workshops to educate clients on effectively using the platform’s advertising features, fostering long-term client relationships and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product Development: Provide feedback to the product development team regarding client needs and industry trends, helping to refine and enhance the platform’s advertising benefits for greater market relevance.
  • Drive Client Acquisition & Retention: Proactively identify opportunities to acquire new clients and retain existing ones by showcasing the unique advantages and results that the platform’s advertising solutions deliver within the commercial real estate market.
  • Stay Current with Industry Trends: Keep updated with digital advertising and commercial real estate trends to ensure the platform remains competitive and aligned with market demands.
  • Take initiative to experiment, refine processes, and share ideas to help SiiLA scale in the Brazil Market and beyond.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects, clients, and industry stakeholders, maintaining trust and delivering value .
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and exceptional client experiences .

What Makes You a Great Fit:

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

· A minimum of three years of experience in Marketing sales, preferably within commercial real estate, technology, or a related industry.

· Strong business sense with the ability to qualify prospects effectively and identify opportunities for tailored solutions in Marketing.

· A natural curiosity and willingness to dive into data, technology, and market trends to build expertise and credibility.

· Entrepreneurial mindset with a drive to contribute to the growth of a fast-evolving organization and make a measurable impact.

· Excellent interpersonal skills and clear, effective communication in both English and Portuguese.

· Persistence and resilience in handling objections, with the ability to bounce back and stay motivated .

· Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities, stay on top of leads, and deliver results .

· Confidence and presence to engage with executives while remaining personable and approachable.

· Coachable and adaptable , with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to apply feedback effectively.

Follow us: @siila.br
