title: ServiceNow Technical Expert
description:
ServiceNow Technical Expert

Organization: BEXIT (Business Excellence & IT Strategy)

Reporting: Reports to Christian Daller, Head of BEXIT

Position Type: Individual Contributor

Role Description:

The ServiceNow Technical Expert will play a pivotal role in building and evolving ServiceNow as the “IT ERP” for the newco IT organization. This individual will take hands-on architectural decisions, guide and supervise external partners in development and application management, and directly contribute to configuration, development, and administration of ServiceNow. The role will consult and guide on architectural and configuration decisions across a broad range of modules—including SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, custom apps, integrations, and more—ensuring ServiceNow meets the needs of a modern, integrated IT landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make hands-on architectural decisions for ServiceNow configuration and development.
  • Guide and supervise external partners responsible for ServiceNow development and application management.
  • Perform configuration, development, and administration tasks within ServiceNow.
  • Collaborate closely with the DSM ServiceNow, Enterprise Architect, and Process Owners to ensure alignment with strategic roadmaps and project scopes.
  • Investigate and advise on module usage, integrations, and platform capabilities across such as, but not limited to, SPM, ITSM, ITOM, HR, VR, and custom applications.
  • Ensure platform design follows best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Represent BEXIT as a subject matter expert in cross-functional meetings and initiatives
  • Training: Provide Training regarding ServiceNow stretching from End Users to Technical Staff and Architects.

Expectations:

  • Prioritize out-of-the-box functionality and avoid custom development unless justified by business case, legal, EHS, or security requirements.
  • Follow ServiceNow best practices to ensure scalability, maintainability, and minimal technical debt.
  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and consultative guidance across modules.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with the enterprise roadmap and scoped demands.

Qualifications:

  • Must-Have: ServiceNow Administrator certification or equivalent. Additional certifications in the context of ITIL functionality are beneficial.
  • Proven experience in scripting and integration within ServiceNow.
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).
  • Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as CSDM and TOGAF.
  • Experience across multiple ServiceNow modules.
  • Understanding of enterprise IT transformation and ERP-like platform design.

Authorization:

  • Make architectural and configuration decisions within the roadmap provided by the Enterprise Architect and the scope defined by Process Owners and DSMs.
  • Represent BEXIT in cross-functional meetings and initiatives as a subject matter expert (SME).
  • Approve configuration and development work that aligns with best practices and avoids unnecessary customization or technical debt.
  • Guide and supervise external partners in development and application management activities.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

Company Information

A rapidly scaling technology organization delivering advanced AI-powered software to enterprise and public-sector customers. The company builds intelligent systems that combine world-class engineering with real-world usability, enabling clients to automate workflows, make better decisions, and move faster.

Teams operate with a product-first mindset, tight feedback loops, and a strong partnership culture. You’ll work directly with customers, internal engineering, and product leads to bring cutting-edge AI solutions into production environments.

Job Information

The company is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, problem-solving, and customer impact.

You’ll work closely with clients to deeply understand their workflows, translate needs into technical implementations, and deploy AI-driven solutions that deliver measurable value. This role is part architect, part builder, part advisor—perfect for someone who loves shipping real systems, not just writing docs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work directly with customer stakeholders to understand business problems and map technical solutions
  • Deploy, integrate, and customize AI and ML-powered products within client environments
  • Build data pipelines, APIs, automations, and lightweight applications to support deployment
  • Configure and optimize LLM-based systems, retrieval pipelines, and agent workflows
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams to inform product direction and feature design
  • Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of deployed systems
  • Troubleshoot issues in real time and guide customers through adoption and best practices
  • Create documentation, solution architectures, and integration guides

What You Bring

  • Strong software engineering background (Python required; bonus for JS/TS, Go, or cloud-native tools)
  • Experience deploying or integrating production systems in fast-paced environments
  • Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, vector search, APIs, orchestration tools, or applied ML workflows
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and solve open-ended problems with minimal direction
  • Excellent communication skills — comfortable working directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A product mindset with a bias toward shipping solutions quickly and iterating

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience in consulting, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or FDE roles
  • Experience with security-conscious or regulated environments
  • Knowledge of DevOps, MLOps, or distributed systems

About Us

A hands-on, mission-driven team building AI systems that enhance human capability and accelerate real-world outcomes. The culture values ownership, clarity, experimentation, and delivering solutions that solve actual customer problems—not hypothetical ones.

Why Join Us

You’ll work on meaningful deployments where your work is immediately visible, impactful, and essential to customer success. Expect autonomy, direct access to leadership, and the opportunity to shape how organizations adopt and apply AI at scale.

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Bilingual English | Portuguese)
description:

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests.   • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: C# Electronic Trading Developer
description:

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Additionally, we conduct extensive training and knowledge transfer sessions, ensuring client teams are equipped to maximize the value of their technology investments.

• Design and develop robust, scalable applications supporting E-Trading systems across asset classes

• Work with trading, operations, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver effective solutions

• Apply sound design and architecture principles, using data structures and algorithms for performance

• Stay current with technologies and industry trends, particularly within algorithmic and e-Trading platforms

• Analyze and resolve system bottlenecks, performance issues, and application bugs

• Hands-on experience with C# - including experience in electronic trading platforms

• Experience with unit testing and CI/CD pipelines

• Knowledge on one of the following: Equities; FX; Rates; Credit; and Derivatives is a plus

• In-depth knowledge of multithreading, memory management, and low-latency systems

• Solid understanding of design & architecture principles, common data structures and algorithms complexity

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, tools like Intellij, JIRA and Confluence and version control in Git

• Fluency in English (both written and spoken)

Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Angular Developer
description:
Angular Developer - Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres

Language: English & Portuguese

Duration: 1 year

Position: Hybrid, 2x to 3x in Office

Experience: 5 to 8 years

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Angular Developer to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals with strong expertise in designing and developing front-end solutions and large-scale intranet/internet applications. The ideal candidate will have deep knowledge of Angular (version 14+), PrimeNG, and modern web technologies, along with experience in micro frontends and component library creation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable front-end applications using Angular 14+ and PrimeNG 14+.
  • Translate Figma UX designs into functional Angular components.
  • Integrate backend APIs with Angular applications.
  • Implement micro frontends and reusable component libraries.
  • Apply reactive programming principles using RxJS.
  • Ensure responsive design and cross-browser compatibility using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and JavaScript.
  • Utilize tools like Node.js, Jenkins, OpenShift, and Autosys as needed.
  • Conduct unit testing using Jasmine and Karma.
  • Manage source code using Git and track tasks/issues with JIRA.
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum environments and participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work with MongoDB/Oracle databases when required.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, system design, and architecture.
  • Communicate effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Lead and manage successful project implementations.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in application development.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and project needs.

Qualifications:

  • 5 to 8 years of experience in front-end development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Angular (version 8 or above), preferably Angular 14+.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JSON, and Ajax.
  • Experience with RxJS and reactive programming.
  • Familiarity with Node.js, Jenkins, OpenShift, and Autosys is a plus.
  • Experience with micro frontend architecture and component library creation.
  • Knowledge of Jasmine & Karma for testing.
  • Experience with SCM tools like Git and project management tools like JIRA.
  • Agile/Scrum methodology experience.
  • Experience with MongoDB or Oracle databases is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, design, and architecture skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage and deliver successful projects.

Certification (Preferred):

  • Professional Angular Developer Certification – Level 2

title: Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets.
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta.
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry.
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience.
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Have excellent business negotiation and market development capabilities, be loyal to business goals, have insight into the needs of users, and be brave to embrace challenges.
  • Have basic data analysis skills and master office software applications. Experience in working with charts/graphs is required.
  • Integrity, honesty and resilience. Passionate about work and possessing a strong team spirit.
  • English and Portuguese can be used as working languages.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

description:

A TMF Group ajuda seus clientes a operar internacionalmente e 'pertencer' a qualquer lugar do mundo. Nosso trabalho inclui apoiar empresas de todos os tamanhos com serviços como RH e Folha de Pagamento, Contabilidade, Secretariado Corporativo, Governança Global e Administração e Serviços Fiduciários para Finanças Estruturadas, Private Equity e Investimentos Imobiliários. O QUE TEMOS

Impacto Internacional

Seja parte do One TMF

title: Territory Manager
description:
XPEL, Inc. (NASDAQ: XPEL), a leading supplier of automotive paint protection films, window films, ceramic coatings, and commercial/residential flat glass films, is currently seeking a Territory Manager for the Southern Brazil region (Porto Alegre/Florianópolis/Curitiba)

Resumo da Vaga:

O Territory Manager será responsável pelas vendas gerais dos produtos XPEL em sua área de atuação.

Esse profissional atuará tanto com concessionárias quanto com instaladores independentes, ou em uma combinação de ambos, dependendo do potencial do mercado local.

O mercado automotivo contemplado inclui o segmento de pós-venda automotivo (aftermarket) — abrangendo instaladores de películas automotivas (window fims, PPF), studios de detalhamento automotivo, franquias e instaladores profissionais independentes — além de novas concessionárias de veículos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerir e expandir as vendas no território designado, com foco em atingir ou superar as metas de crescimento.
  • Atuar de forma ativa em vendas, estando em campo cerca de 50% do tempo com clientes atuais e potenciais.
  • Manter e aprimorar a satisfação dos clientes, oferecendo um serviço excepcional e construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Monitorar e analisar o uso dos produtos pelos clientes, identificando oportunidades para introdução de novos produtos e maximização de receita.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver relacionamentos comerciais, fornecendo relatórios gerenciais regulares conforme necessário.
  • Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes, garantindo comunicação e suporte eficazes por meio de diversos canais (e-mail, telefone, apresentações online, compartilhamento de tela e reuniões presenciais).
  • Realizar análises de mercado e desenvolver estratégias de aquisição e conquista de novos clientes.
  • Fazer o follow-up de leads de vendas, colaborando com a equipe de Administração de Vendas para garantir a integração e onboarding eficiente de novos clientes.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os Gerentes de Loja e Instaladores Chefes, assegurando a perfeita coordenação entre as áreas de vendas e operações.
  • Prospectar novas oportunidades de crescimento, criando iniciativas estratégicas e ações proativas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações do setor automotivo, participando de treinamentos internos, lendo publicações especializadas e ampliando sua rede de contatos profissionais.

Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência profissional em vendas, com histórico comprovado de resultados.
  • Perfil proativo, altamente motivado e organizado.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, análise e resolução de problemas.
  • Forte capacidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamento com clientes.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (cerca de 50%).
  • Carteira de habilitação válida, com histórico de direção limpo.
  • Residência dentro do território designado.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões adequadas, com foco em atendimento ao cliente, segurança e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. Com uma trajetória marcada pela excelência e inovação, a empresa oferece soluções completas e personalizadas para atender às necessidades de segurança de seus clientes, sejam eles residenciais, comerciais ou industriais.

A atuação da Patrimonial Segurança é pautada em três pilares fundamentais:

· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

· Equipe Altamente Capacitada: Os profissionais da Patrimonial Segurança passam por rigorosos processos de seleção, treinamento contínuo e atualizações, assegurando que estejam preparados para lidar com diferentes cenários e desafios de segurança.

· Atendimento Personalizado: Cada cliente recebe uma análise detalhada das necessidades de segurança, resultando em planos de ação específicos, capazes de prevenir riscos e proteger bens e pessoas de maneira eficaz.

A empresa se destaca por sua ética profissional, compromisso com a qualidade e foco na construção de relacionamentos de confiança com seus clientes.

Com presença sólida na região de Chapecó e Itajaí, a Patrimonial Segurança é mais do que uma prestadora de serviços; é uma parceira estratégica na proteção de bens e na promoção da tranquilidade.

Estamos em busca de um (a) Gestor de Negócios (a) – Comercial PJ para integrar nosso time!

Atuar na prospecção, venda e gestão de novos contratos, além de realizar o atendimento e manutenção da carteira ativa de clientes, garantindo resultados comerciais consistentes e alinhados às metas da empresa.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Financial Cents to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Financial Cents or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.

What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche

First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning

Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Product Designer Sênior - São Paulo/SP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Hibrido. 1 a 2 vezes por semana em Perdizes/São Paulo.
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Product Designer responsável por projetar produtos com experiências intuitivas e envolventes, focando na solução de problemas de negócio por meio de princípios de design centrado no usuário. O objetivo é desenvolver soluções efetivas que ofereçam experiências únicas e personalizadas para nossos clientes, atendendo às necessidades específicas de cada segmento, desde a pesquisa inicial até a entrega de soluções visualmente atraentes e altamente funcionais.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Você será uma peça-chave em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto, com as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Diagnóstico: Identificar problemas e oportunidades analisando as dores dos usuários e as metas do negócio.
  • Pesquisa: Conduzir entrevistas, mapear jornadas e interpretar dados analíticos para guiar decisões.
  • Criação: Idear soluções criativas e muito significativas para as pessoas usuárias, trazendo experiências fluidas, lindas e, por que não, surpreendentes.
  • Prototipação e Design: Desenvolver fluxos, wireframes e interfaces impecáveis com componentes detalhados e organizados no Figma, garantindo adesão ao Design System e práticas de acessibilidade.
  • Validação: Realizar testes de usabilidade, aplicar testes A/B, validar a viabilidade técnica das soluções junto às equipes de engenharia e acompanhar métricas pós-lançamento para ajustar e aprimorar as entregas.
  • Colaboração: Atuar em uma equipe multidisciplinar, interna e externa, participando de rituais e tomadas de decisão, liderando projetos que promovam a interação entre designers e outros times, além de colaborar diretamente com equipes de engenharia para garantir a implementação eficaz das soluções.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Foco no usuário: Antecipar e atender às necessidades dos usuários dentro de um time de produto, garantindo soluções que agreguem valor e proporcionem boas experiências.
  • Comunicação e negociação: Colaborar com equipes de negócios e engenharia, traduzindo problemas complexos em soluções práticas e funcionais.
  • Tomada de decisão: Ter embasamento e agir com segurança e assertividade ao tomar decisões importantes.
  • Paixão pelo design: Interesse genuíno em participar de todas as etapas do processo de design, desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Formação e ferramentas: Formação em Design, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas, com experiência sólida no uso de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe Illustrator e Photoshop.
  • Design System e acessibilidade: Domínio guias de estilo e práticas de acessibilidade, incluindo cores, contrastes e padrões de usabilidade.
  • Pesquisa e análise: Habilidade em conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas de avaliação do produto, sempre transformando dados em insights estratégicos.
  • Apresentação de ideias: Capacidade de articular propostas e apresentar soluções baseadas em dados e insights do usuário.
  • Habilidade de antecipar problemas e adaptação a cenários imprevisíveis: A candidata/o deve ser proativa/o na identificação de desafios antecipados e capaz de se adaptar rapidamente a mudanças inesperadas, ajustando soluções para garantir a eficácia e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência prática no uso de Inteligência Artificial em seus processos criativos.

title: Electrical Engineering analyst (R&D)
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an Electrical Engineering analyst to join our R&D team. This role focuses on the design, development, and testing of electrical and electronic systems for new products, ensuring seamless transition from concept to production. The specialist will collaborate with suppliers, manufacturing, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and cost-competitive products.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and refine the design of electrical components to support scalable and efficient product manufacturing.
  • Collaborate closely with suppliers to develop and qualify electrical components, ensuring alignment with production requirements.

  • Liaise with suppliers and external partners to source components and resolve technical challenges.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in electrical design, testing, and manufacturing support within an R&D environment.
  • Proficiency with electrical design software (e.g., CAD, simulation tools) and testing equipment.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical safety standards and product certification processes.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to travel as necessary.

Differentials:

  • Experience in the home appliance, HVAC, or durable goods industries.
  • Knowledge of embedded systems and firmware development.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes and supplier management.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

title: Golang Back End Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Mid-level / Mid+ Go Backend Engineer to build and operate high-throughput microservices.

You’ll focus on performance, reliability, and clean design, using profilers and remote debugging to keep services fast and stable in production.

Location

  • Remote

**We kindly ask you to send your CV in English, as it is the official language of the HORISEN group.

***Mid-level / Mid+ Go (Golang) Backend Engineer — High Load & Microservices.

Requirements

  • Design, build, and operate Go microservices for high-load, low-latency workloads (REST/gRPC)
  • Profile and optimize code (CPU/memory/trace) using pprof, go tool trace, flame graphs
  • Perform remote debugging in real environments (Delve, VS Code Remote, port-forwarding)
  • Write robust unit tests (table-driven) and meaningful benchmarks (go test -bench), keep coverage healthy
  • Integrate with data/streaming systems: Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse
  • Ship via GitLab CI/CD (pipelines, runners, Docker images); automate quality gates
  • Contribute to service observability (metrics/logging/tracing/Prometheus/OpenTelemetry/Jaeger)
  • Apply design patterns and clean architecture; participate in code/design reviews

Must have

  • 2–3+ years of backend experience, 2+ with Go in production
  • Strong Go fundamentals: concurrency (goroutines, channels, context, sync), profiling, performance tuning
  • Hands-on microservices experience (Docker)
  • Remote debugging proficiency (Delve) and production troubleshooting skills
  • Solid testing discipline (unit tests, benchmarks) and GitLab CI/CD experience
  • Practical knowledge of REST/gRPC and at least one of Kafka/Redis/MongoDB/ClickHouse
  • Familiarity with design patterns, SOLID/clean architecture, idiomatic Go

Nice to have

  • Deeper expertise with Kafka (consumer groups, idempotency, exactly-once patterns), schema registry (Avro/Protobuf)
  • ClickHouse performance tuning; Redis as cache/rate-limit/locks; MongoDB schema design
  • Observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Loki)

Why join

  • Impact: own services that process real traffic at scale
  • Modern stack, strong engineering culture, code reviews, technical growth

title: Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Equity Only / Part-Time) - Build a Global Mental Health Platform (US-Based)
description:
To our friends in Brazil: We are specifically recruiting here because the React/Next.js talent is world-class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge: Keep your day job, contribute 5-10 hours/week, and earn substantial equity in a US-based C-Corp.

This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.

Unacceptable. We're fixing it.

Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider-centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.

Next: an AI-powered booking and translation layer with real-time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system-level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.

The Opportunity: Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment: 5-10 hours/week, equity-only, alongside your primary role.

You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.

We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.

Who You Are (and how you show up)

  • Mission-obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.
  • Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.
  • Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.
  • Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.
  • Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low-ego reviews.
  • Efficiency and Output Driven: Comfortable leaning hard on tools like Cursor, Claude, or Copilot to move 2x faster, or excited to learn and get there fast.

What You'll Build (and why it matters)

End-to-end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next:

  1. Add recurring calendar availability
  2. Publish existing SEO content at scale and optimize the site
  3. Roll out the Hotline
  4. Complete Talk Now (instant sessions) and Find Matches (survey → ranked suggestions)
  5. Add location-based navigation
  6. Add site-wide translation and real-time audio translation
  7. API/MCP integrations

Our stack: Next.js/React on the front; Python services; Postgres underneath; GitHub, AI-assisted workflows (Cursor/Copilot) to move faster without lowering the bar.

The Deal: Transparent Equity Partnership

  • Merit-based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.
  • Points-for-outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.
  • All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential “glue work” like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.
  • Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.
  • Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6-month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3-year period.
  • Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.
  • High-impact bounties. Mission-critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.
  • Locked-in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.
  • No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.

Why This Will Define Your Career

  • Build Your US Track Record: This is your entry point into the US startup ecosystem. You aren't outsourcing; you are a partner.
  • USD-Denominated Upside: You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar-based asset ($100M+ target valuation).
  • Direct Access: You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.
  • Human Impact: Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.

Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.

This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.

To Apply: Send:

  • GitHub (or 1-2 PRs you're proud of) If you can include links to the actual PRs or issues (and a sentence or two of context), even better.
  • A short note: why this mission, and one gnarly problem you've shipped through

If you talk in hours, skip. If you talk in shipped outcomes, welcome.

  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.

Desired Profile:

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
* OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

I MPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.

Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Senior Java Technical Lead (AI-Augmented Development)
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Technical Lead to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, with a strong culture of engineering excellence and innovation.

This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.

About the Role

As a Senior Java Technical Lead , you will be responsible for leading all technical decision-making across backend and frontend development, ensuring architectural consistency, engineering best practices, and high-quality code delivery.

This role requires an expert-level Java professional who has begun integrating AI-assisted development workflows , including LLMs such as GPT and Claude, into their software engineering practices.

You will lead full-stack developers, collaborate closely with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and AI Engineers, and oversee complex business domains such as Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance .

If you are a seasoned Java engineer who is also evolving into the new era of AI-enhanced software development, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical decision-making across backend and frontend architecture.
  • Ensure code quality, engineering best practices, and architectural coherence.
  • Guide full-stack developers implementing backend services and UI components.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architect, BA, DevOps, and AI Engineer to translate requirements into scalable, secure solutions.
  • Oversee complex financial and operational domains (Billing, Ledger, Invoice, Remittance).
  • Design, supervise, and optimize workflows that leverage LLMs for code generation, review, and refactoring.
  • Provide technical leadership on when and how to use AI tools safely and effectively.

Required Qualifications

Core Engineering Skills:

  • Senior-level Java/Spring Boot experience (expert level required).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and Postgres .
  • Experience with Security, DevOps, Cloud , and GitHub ecosystem.
  • GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.

Cloud & Infrastructure:

  • Strong experience with AWS Identity Management .
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS workloads: EC2, RDS, SQS .

AI & LLM Experience (Required):

  • Solid understanding of LLMs and its capabilities.
  • Experience with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or similar models for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering , including:
  • Structured prompting
  • Chain-of-thought patterns
  • Constraints-driven prompting
  • Code-oriented prompting
  • Ability to guide developers on the safe, effective use of AI tools in daily engineering work.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical fields.
  • Experience leading distributed development teams.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and enterprise-level systems.

The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Why Join Us?

title: Operador(a) de Produção de Painéis IV (MDF)
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Responder por executar e conduzir as atividades das linhas de produção em que atua, contribuindo para que os produtos estejam dentro das especificações definidas e prezando pelo cumprimento dos requisitos de qualidade, segurança e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Executar as atividades pertinentes a fabricação dos produtos podendo operar máquinas e/ou equipamentos conforme instrução de trabalho;
  • Acionar e apoiar a equipe de manutenção quando necessário, assegurando todos os procedimentos de segurança para o apoio a estas atividades;
  • Realizar apontamentos das informações sobre segurança, qualidade, produtividade e consumo reportando ao superior imediato as não conformidades e sugestões de melhoria;
  • Realizar a classificação do material conforme as especificações e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar o check list de inspeção e planos de limpeza diário;
  • Realizar análise de falhas e de desvios do Processo e Qualidade;
  • Abertura de notas e etiquetas para manutenção;
  • Participar da elaboração de procedimentos e instruções de trabalho;
  • Participar da rotina semanal de limpeza de equipamentos críticos;
  • Participar em projetos de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos:

description:

title: Analista de Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.

Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes

OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.

FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:

  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.

FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.

REQUISITOS

Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em uma posição similar atuando em um dos ramos: Responsabilidade civil (RC), Riscos Nomeados e Compreensivo empresarial.
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial

Habilidades (Pleno) em:

  • Gestão do Tempo
  • Integração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Empatia
  • Habilidade de Comunicação Assertiva
  • Pensamento Analítico
  • Proatividade e postura resolutiva

title: Modelador(a) Matemático(a) para Hidrogeologia e Transporte de Contaminantes
description:
Buscamos profissional para integrar nossa equipe técnica em projetos de modelagem de fluxo da água subterrânea e/ou transporte de contaminantes.

Atuará no desenvolvimento de modelos conceituais e tradução para modelos numéricos, calibração dos modelos, simulações preditivas e interpretação de resultados para suporte à tomada de decisão em projetos ambientais.

Responsabilidades

  • Interpretação de dados hidrogeológicos e de qualidade da água.
  • Elaboração de modelos conceituais a partir de dados de campo e relatórios técnicos.
  • Construção e calibração de modelos de fluxo da água subterrânea e de transporte de contaminantes.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Geologia.
  • Tempo de formação entre 3 e 7 anos.
  • Conhecimento básico em hidrogeologia e comportamento de contaminantes.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem matemática (pode ser experiência acadêmica).
  • Experiência prévia no software Visual MODFLOW;
  • Boa capacidade analítica e organização.
  • Familiaridade com Excel e softwares GIS.
  • Saber ler em inglês.
  • Boa redação técnica.

Desejável

  • Experiência prévia em modelos como MT3D, RT3D, MODPATH e outros códigos complementares à modelagem.
